case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd the longest-running commitment from us, and our side of the relationship is already solid:

Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm it as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As inside sales, you may need to take it to the person who decides on your side, so we would be grateful if you would put Option A before them.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We would like to settle this as a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that our detailed cost structures are proprietary and cannot be shared. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We appreciate your proposal and are willing to accommodate the 24-month contract term and 45-day payment period. However, we cannot meet your target price and can offer €4.90 per unit for this package. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €4.90 per unit, a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

That is the basis of Option A, and it gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a longer-running commitment from a long-standing customer.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It brings your wish for a multi-year agreement together with a clear, steady relationship between two family companies. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this decision may not rest with you alone, we would ask you to take Option A to the person who decides on your side. Options B and C are there only for your convenience.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your preference for Option A. As your trusted distributor, we always value our business relationship and aim to support your operations with our extensive range and high service standards.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can make a slight adjustment to a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This represents our firm position for this package. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We hope these updated terms meet your requirements and look forward to continuing our cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it is the multi-year agreement that you told us changes prices on standard items.

Since this decision is likely to go beyond your desk, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides on your side.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We have reviewed your preferred option with our management as requested.

We are unable to offer further concessions, so the price of €4.89 for a 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms stands. This represents our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For your review, our offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative package, we can present a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We value you as a customer and look forward to hearing your decision soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You asked us to decide, and we have. After your review with your management, we accept your alternative proposal as offered. It gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd the multi-year agreement you told us is the only way prices on standard items change.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 4.89; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

This is Option A as it stands, and it is the package we can approve. If you confirm it, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you work with the terms and conditions on your side, please take this to the person who decides at your end, so that we can close it cleanly for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We are pleased to confirm your acceptance of our final offer. We can accept your terms and await your order. 

We will prepare the contract for the 24-month term at €4.89 per unit with 45 days net payment. As stated, our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. For your records, our Angebot features a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid for 14 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure to serve you with our broad range and high-standard service, and we look forward to continuing our great cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
